Name: Never Go Home Empty-Handed
Author: qingyf
Description:
Tired of sitting by the water all day only to reel in a soggy old boot?
Sick of your spouse yelling, "You've been staring at the river again—where's the fish?" while you hang your head in shame?
Fed up with being mocked as the "fishing atmosphere crew" because you came back empty-handed yet again?
[b]This MOD is your salvation, tailor-made for you![/b]
Just [b]hold down the fishing rod button[/b] —
and fish will line up like they're rushing to a sale, hooking themselves one after another without stopping!
Never worry about going home empty-handed again. You'll go from "bait boy" to "lake-clearer" in seconds.
[quote]⚠️ Side effects may include:
[list]
[*]Fishing loses its soul (but who cares?)[/*]
[/list][/quote]
